headline: Public hearings on liquor license change at 115 East Main St and new liquor license for Mehfil restaurant at 226 Washington St.
summary: The board will hold public hearings on a change of license class for Rocky Neck Lobster Company II at 115 East Main St and a new all alcoholic beverages license for Gloucester Restaurant Group, dba Mehfil, at 226 Washington St. It will also consider a one-day liquor license for a fundraiser at Hammond Castle Museum and discuss annual liquor license renewal meetings.
items: Public hearing: Petition of Rocky Neck Lobster Company II for a Change of Class for the On-Premise, Section 12, Annual Restaurant, All Alcoholic Beverages License at 115 East Main St, Building 121, Manager of Record: Dawn Caraway
Public hearing: Petition of Gloucester Restaurant Group, dba Mehfil, for a new Annual, Section 12 All Alcoholic Beverages License at 226 Washington St, Manager of Record: Prabjhot Pabla

Special One Day Liquor License: Petition of Linda Harvey to serve all alcoholic beverages at the Goblin King Ball/Gala Fundraiser on 10/30/2026 and 10/31/2026 at the Hammond Castle Museum, 80 Hesperus Ave
Discussion on Annual Liquor License Renewals special meetings
location: Harbor Master's Conference Room, Harbor Master's Office, 19 Harbor Loop, #2, Gloucester, MA 01930
